Scene:
Create a square art-science image that presents a tesseract projection with the clarity of a premium museum plate. The camera should remain frontal and calm, while lighting, materials, or color systems help distinguish nested cubes, edge depth, and rotational phase relationships without turning the composition into a generic user interface. Keep the mood atmospheric but the geometry strict, as if a scientific object were lit inside a silent observatory. Keep the square crop exact, the camera flat, and the tonal design disciplined enough that structure stays clear at poster scale and under close inspection.

Subject:
Use a tesseract or closely related hypercube projection as the structural centerpiece, with nested cube frames, bridging edges, phase echoes, and disciplined auxiliary diagrams. The geometry should feel reasoned and coherent, so the viewer can understand the higher-dimensional idea through a stable, elegant projection rather than through visual chaos. Focus this variation on a moody blue-black study where the tesseract casts carefully layered shadows through a cosmic yet disciplined field. The composition should feel complete and singular, as though one finished artifact has been resolved with full conviction rather than one fragment pulled from a larger sheet.

Important details:
Edge count, hierarchy, and spacing matter more than flashy effects. Keep the central projection readable, preserve clean line convergence, and let any supporting phase views, orbit traces, or cutaway layers clarify the concept. Use contrast and color coding only where they make the dimensional relationships more legible. Shadows must reinforce nested volume relationships and never blur the actual edge count or cube hierarchy. Preserve crisp edge behavior, stable hierarchy, and enough fine information that the image rewards slow viewing without losing the main read from a distance.

items.title: Silhouette Study
items.fullOriginalPrompt:
Scene:
Create a square cinematic still for Aurora Glacier Silent Theatre. Use production-grade photoreal lighting, disciplined lens behavior, and a composition that feels like a finished key frame from an original film rather than a casual snapshot. An Arctic glacier plain opens under a sweeping aurora curtain, with deep night sky, luminous green and faint violet ribbons overhead, fractured ice catching reflected color, and a breath-frozen atmosphere that feels almost soundless. Compose an independent frame where one human, animal, or object silhouette negotiates with the atmospheric light event in a clean, readable way.

Subject:
Build a coherent original scene whose emotional center comes from atmosphere, light physics, and spatial clarity. Avoid relying on celebrity likeness, franchise iconography, or stylized illustration shortcuts. A solitary human figure in a red parka should appear tiny against the glacier geometry, while crevasses, wind-scoured snow, and ice walls provide a strong sense of scale without cluttering the frame. The silhouette should supply scale and emotional orientation, but the environment still needs to carry most of the storytelling weight.

Important details:
Preserve a believable physical world with strong depth layering, careful color separation, and premium image discipline. Keep the aurora soft and physically plausible rather than graphic, with believable ice reflectance, low-angle moonless ambient light, and careful contrast so the red parka remains a scale marker rather than a fashion focal point. Keep the silhouette simple and believable, avoiding poster-like graphic flattening while preserving strong contrast.

Use case:
Aurora Glacier single study 6/9.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no tents, no readable expedition logos, no fantasy animals, no saturated nightclub colors, no fireworks effect.

items.title: Pumpkin Market
items.fullOriginalPrompt:
Scene:
A square moonlit storybook world built from crooked fences, leaning roofs, spiraled trees, pointed hills, and glowing orange windows against blue-violet night. The image should feel handcrafted and whimsical but also melancholic, with strong silhouettes and a theatrical sense of depth. Create a moonlit market lane lined with carved pumpkins, tilted awnings, and strings of dim lanterns between crooked houses.

Subject:
Include one central wanderer or small resident figure whose oversized eyes, slight body, and clear silhouette anchor the scene. The town itself should seem alive with curl, tilt, and delicate unease, as if every branch and roofline was bent by the same strange lullaby. A child figure in a stitched coat stands amid the pumpkins, face lit from below by one glowing lantern gourd.

Important details:
The visual law is gothic playfulness through spirals, cut-paper silhouettes, and warm-cool contrast. Preserve curling trunks, scalloped clouds, crooked pickets, and glowing window rectangles without referencing any existing characters or properties. Avoid cute modern merchandising polish or generic fantasy clutter. Use orange glows as punctuation in a blue-black world, keeping the market sparse and theatrical rather than festive crowd chaos.

Use case:
Gothic Fable Spiral Town single study 8/9.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no readable signs, no branded mascots, no realistic suburban details, no photoreal human anatomy, no daytime sunlight, no broken anatomy, no low-detail background, no accidental text fragments.

items.title: Reference Hero Anchor
items.fullOriginalPrompt:
Scene:
Create a polished square hero-introduction frame with a controlled studio-cinematic hybrid setup. The camera sits at a three-quarter full-body distance, slightly below eye level so the figure feels playable and aspirational without becoming exaggerated poster fantasy. Use a soft storm-gray gradient background, a faint illuminated floor ring, and crisp rim light that separates the character silhouette from the backdrop. Brightness should be concentrated on the face, chest reactor, and shoulder mantle, while the corners stay quiet and clean for downstream marketing reuse. The overall image must feel like a finished launch anchor that can guide later references across poster, bust crop, banner, and production-sheet outputs.

Subject:
Center an original playable heroine with warm umber skin, an angular heart-shaped face, high cheekbones, a slim slash scar through the left eyebrow, alert amber-brown eyes, and short ivory-white hair cut into an undercut with one long braided tail. Preserve athletic dancer-sprinter build with long legs, narrow waist, and confident upright posture. Her costume language is fixed: asymmetrical teal shoulder mantle, ember-orange bodysuit, graphite segmented armor, ivory scarf tabs, crescent chest reactor, slim ring-blade sidearm, and split cape panels. Keep the body turned slightly off-axis with one foot forward, one hand relaxed near the ring-blade holster, and the other hand open in a calm charge-ready gesture. The expression should be focused, composed, and unmistakably heroic rather than aggressive. The face must be highly legible and repeatable, with the same eyebrow scar, hairline, braid length, cheekbone shape, nose bridge, lip shape, and eye spacing that all later images will preserve.

Important details:
The visual language must balance promo polish with production clarity. Lock the faction palette to teal, ember orange, gunmetal, and soft ivory, keep armor seams believable, and let the chest reactor read as a crescent motif that can recur in every asset. Do not overfill the background. The silhouette should stay readable from thumbnail distance: angular shoulder mantle on one side, narrow waist, long legs, and split cape panels. Materials should feel like premium stylized game rendering, with matte armor, satin fabric, soft skin texture, and controlled emissive accents.

Use case:
Hero Reveal Turnaround Pack series study 1/9, establishing the canonical hero identity for all launch and turnaround assets.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no extra characters, no oversized weapon swing, no chaotic background scenery, no costume redesign, no face drift, no inaccurate anatomy.

A square prestige-series key art image inside a mountain monastery archive lit by cold dawn light from high windows and a few warm practical lamps. Stone columns, paper screens, and tiered shelves create a disciplined architectural frame. The mood is contemplative but dangerous, with heavy silence and a premium photographic finish that suggests serious serialized drama rather than mystical fantasy.

Subject:
Create a fictional ensemble of five conspirators embedded inside a religious institution. The lead is a young abbess in layered charcoal robes, centered and poised, holding neither weapon nor scripture but commanding the scene through stillness. Around her stand a war-scarred monk, an aristocratic donor in understated silk, a novice archivist with divided loyalty, and a severe investigator from the capital. Arrange them so the abbess is clearly the emotional center while the others form a network of suspicion and dependency. Their faces must feel lived-in, subtle, and complex, avoiding caricature.

Important details:
This study depends on relationship geometry more than overt plot props. Use posture, depth, and gaze to imply secret factions inside a closed institution. Maintain a restrained palette and sparse set dressing so the image reads like premium key art. The environment should feel real and expensive, not stagey. Keep clothing textures, age differences, and personal histories legible at thumbnail scale.
